purpose: Correct the invalid independence assumption in the v1 pooled df=5 bound while every finalist checkpoint/result path remains absent and without changing any materialized run config.

predecessor.flaw: the primary df=5 t-bound treated six seed-by-data-order cells as independent even though seeds and orders are reused in a crossed design

method_sources.title: Robust Inference with Multi-way Clustering
method_sources.use: establishes that crossed non-nested dependence requires multi-way treatment; asymptotic cluster-robust inference is not used with only three and two clusters

method_sources.title: Inference with Few Heterogeneous Clusters
method_sources.use: supports t inference over a small number of approximately independent group estimates; the three independently seeded estimates within each fixed order form the eligible groups

method_sources.title: Exploring Interaction Effects in Two-Factor Studies using the hiddenf Package in R
method_sources.use: documents that one observation per crossed factor cell cannot separately identify interaction and residual error without assumptions

statistical_contract.primary_rule: within each frozen data-order stratum, the upper one-sided paired 95% Student-t bound over the three initialization seeds must be at or below 0.01 nats; every one of the six cell differences must also be at or below 0.01
statistical_contract.source_rule: within each frozen data-order stratum, every source-loss upper bound over seeds must be at or below 0.02 nats; every source difference in every cell must also be at or below 0.02
statistical_contract.intersection_union: the whole language screen passes only if both fixed data-order strata and all hard cell/source guards pass; no multiplicity correction is used to claim an intersection
statistical_contract.pooled_cell_summary: report mean, range, and naive df=5 bound descriptively only; it has zero pass/fail authority
statistical_contract.seed_averaged_across_orders: report each seed's two-order mean descriptively; n=2 within-seed inference is forbidden
statistical_contract.scope_limit: the decision establishes robustness only for both frozen data orders over three seeds, not inference to a population of arbitrary data orders

primary_fixed_tokens.authority: two data-order-stratum df=2 bounds plus hard six-cell guards

fixed_analytic_flops.method: piecewise-linear interpolation between enclosing frozen validation boundaries

fixed_steady_training_time.budget: minimum final steady_training_seconds across arms within each pair
fixed_steady_training_time.method: piecewise-linear interpolation excluding startup, validation, checkpointing, and orchestration

time_to_quality.target: lock from all six controls before any candidate result
time_to_quality.method: first piecewise-linear downward crossing in steady training seconds
time_to_quality.censoring: retain every censored pair and form no complete-case bound
time_to_quality.authority: secondary; report order-stratum seed bounds only when all six pairs are uncensored

control_only_target_lock.rule: maximum final validation loss across all six complete dense controls, rounded upward to six decimals

stopping_rule.pair_abandonment: forbidden after seeing either arm's quality
stopping_rule.recovery: resume only the same frozen cell from a contract-valid checkpoint; otherwise retain the failure and preregister any rerun

decision_authority.may: pass or fail the longer-horizon language screen on both fixed data orders and supply one part of architecture-promotion evidence
may_not: attribute benefit to KDA, NoPE, GQA, or the 3:1 ratio
promote without every capability and systems gate
establish novelty or authorize paper-scale training
make serving, long-context, or release claims from language loss

execution.reason: collector/analyzer qualification and automation must be updated to v2 before live launch may be reconsidered
